note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay mapping). Portugal was an EU member state (free trade inside the single market); healthcare is provided mainly through the National Health Service (Serviço Nacional de Saúde); church and state are separate, with Catholicism the majority religion. Energy is set to fossil-first because Portugal had no nuclear power and relied heavily on imported fossil fuels alongside hydropower (gameplay judgement). Conscription is set to selective service: men were still liable to compulsory service until November 2004, but it had been reduced since the early 1990s and almost no conscripts were serving by the end of that decade (Wikipedia: Portuguese Armed Forces).
